title: 正弦量与相量的互换（sin 化为 cos）
tags: 复数的代数形式与极坐标形式
statement: 电流源 i_s(t) = 10√2 sin(1000t + 60°) A 向电阻 R = 2 Ω 供电，电压 u 的参考方向如图（上 + 下 −）。
本题相量一律用**有效值相量**，并以 cos 函数为基准。写出 İ_s，求电压相量 U̇ 的有效值、初相和实部（代数形式 U̇ = a + jb 中的 a）。

questions.ask: U̇ 的实部 a = Re U̇ = ?
同一电路中另一电流 i_2(t) = −5√2 cos(1000t + 30°) A，它的有效值相量 İ_2 是？
questions.explain: 负号相当于相位改变 180°：−cos(x) = cos(x − 180°)，所以 i_2 = 5√2 cos(1000t − 150°) A，İ_2 = 5∠−150° A（也可写成 5∠210° A，但相量的模用有效值 5，不是 5√2）。

hints: 先把 sin 化成 cos：sin(ωt + ψ) = cos(ωt + ψ − 90°)。
有效值相量的模 = 幅值/√2，辐角 = 初相；电阻上 U̇ = R·İ。
代数形式：a = U cos ψ，b = U sin ψ。

en.title: Sinusoid ↔ phasor (turning sin into cos)
statement: The current source i_s(t) = 10√2 sin(1000t + 60°) A feeds a resistor R = 2 Ω; the reference polarity of u is shown (+ at the top).
Use **rms phasors** referenced to the cosine throughout. Write Ī_s and find the rms value, the initial phase and the real part (a in the rectangular form U = a + jb) of the voltage phasor U.

questions.explain: The rms value of Ī_s is 10√2/√2 = 10 A, so U = R·I = 2 × 10 = 20 V.

questions.ask: Initial phase of the phasor U, ψ_u = ?
Real part of the phasor, a = Re U = ?
questions.explain: Polar to rectangular: U = 20cos(−30°) + j20sin(−30°) = 17.32 − j10 V; the real part is 10√3 ≈ 17.32 V.

questions.ask: Another current in the same circuit is i_2(t) = −5√2 cos(1000t + 30°) A. Its rms phasor Ī_2 is:
questions.explain: A minus sign is a 180° phase shift: −cos(x) = cos(x − 180°), so i_2 = 5√2 cos(1000t − 150°) A and Ī_2 = 5∠−150° A (5∠210° A is the same, but the rms magnitude is 5, not 5√2).

hints: Turn sin into cos first: sin(ωt + ψ) = cos(ωt + ψ − 90°).
rms phasor magnitude = amplitude/√2, angle = initial phase; for a resistor U = R·Ī.
Rectangular form: a = U cos ψ, b = U sin ψ.
solution: **4. Rectangular form.** U = 20cos30° − j20sin30° = **17.32** − j10 V.
**5. Back to the time domain.** u(t) = 20√2 cos(1000t − 30°) V ≈ 28.28cos(1000t − 30°) V.
